description: Ledger of system defects found in prior sprint that must be resolved

defects.title: Zero-byte restore logs — no evidence of actual NuGet restore
defects.root_cause: Restore logs were written as empty placeholders. dotnet restore was either not run or stdout not captured.
defects.impact: Cannot verify NuGet package availability for 16 NO_LOWCODE families. Classification evidence is hollow.
defects.resolution: Run actual dotnet restore probe for all 26 families; capture non-empty stdout to restore logs.

defects.title: Assembly manifests missing for 7 of 13 PDF packages
defects.root_cause: Only one PDF manifest created (pdf-controlled-pilot-pr10). The canonical packager cannot drive the remaining 7 PDF subpackages.
defects.impact: Canonical packager cannot reproduce 7 of 13 packages, covering ~33 of 47 examples.
defects.resolution: Create manifests for: pdf-controlled-pilot, pr5, pr6, pr7, pr8, pr9, pr11.

defects.title: Publication denominator inconsistency (47 vs 43 canonical)
defects.root_cause: email-converter is duplicated (2 csproj point to same slug). slides has 3 duplicate slugs (compress/convert/merger appear twice each). True canonical count is 43.
defects.impact: H2 publication readiness matrix says email=1, slides=3 but package contents show 2 and 6 respectively. Counts are contradictory.
defects.resolution: Remove 4 duplicate csproj entries; update all count references to 43 canonical.

defects.title: Artifact metadata SHA baked from wrong ZIP (tmp vs final)
defects.root_cause: build_systemization_26family_zip.py: sha256_file(zip_path_tmp) computed before artifact-metadata files are included in final ZIP. The SHA recorded in artifact-verification.json is for the temp ZIP, not the final ZIP.
defects.impact: Any consumer verifying the artifact SHA will find a mismatch. Bundle-manifest entry_count (247) doesn't match actual ZIP (251 entries).
defects.resolution: Fix build script to compute and record SHA/size/entries of the final ZIP (after all artifact-metadata is included).

defects.title: No forbidden comment scan performed
defects.root_cause: Prior sprint claimed examples are clean but never scanned for 'no suitable overload found', 'TODO', or similar forbidden comments in publication candidates.
defects.impact: Examples submitted to publication may contain developer debug comments.
defects.resolution: Scan all workspace/pr-dry-run/*/Program.cs for forbidden patterns; fix any found.

defects.title: Idempotency claim is single-family only
defects.root_cause: Idempotency proof ran canonical_packager for Words only. Claim 'PROVEN idempotency' is overstated.
defects.impact: Cannot claim repeatable system without idempotency across all 6 families.
defects.resolution: Run A/B idempotency for all 6 LOWCODE families; verify SHA-identical output.

note: All 6 defects will be resolved in lanes B1, D1, D2, E1/E2, G1/G2, K1 of this sprint.
